Mission Local reported in September 2023 that SF State planned staffing cuts that would hit lecturers especially hard. The California Faculty Association said lecturers were told their classes could be reduced or eliminated in spring; the scale would vary by department. The story also reported that the cuts could equal 125 full-time positions, while lecturers—many of them part-time—could be affected in larger numbers.
